name: watermarks-remover
tagline: Strips multi-vendor AI provenance marks from images, documents, and text
description: watermarks-remover is a Python tool for stripping AI provenance marks from content across multiple vendors. It combines Unicode text hygiene with statistical rewrite hooks for text, and removes C2PA metadata from PNG, JPEG, SVG, PDF, DOCX, HTML, and Markdown files. In two days it exploded from nothing to 3.7k stars and became the reference tool in the controversial niche of stripping AI provenance, sparking debate about content authenticity.
highlights: Removes C2PA provenance metadata across PNG, JPEG, SVG, PDF, DOCX, HTML, and MD
Unicode text hygiene plus statistical rewrite hooks for prose
Multi-vendor support — not tied to a single AI provenance scheme
Exploded to 3.7k stars in two days and hit trending #1 globally
Sits at the center of the AI content-authenticity debate
curatorNote: The fastest mover in this batch — 3.7k stars in two days thrust it into trending #1 and made it the reference tool for stripping AI provenance. Controversial, but undeniably the repo defining the conversation this week.
